units.fact: Unit options everywhere on the create screen = company units from GET /v1/dashboard_configuration -> config.units (state.user.units), mapped by selectDefaultUnits to {uuid,name,symbol,conversionFactor}; the dropdown shows only symbols.

Manage Line Items drawer: UnitPicker options = defaultUnits (all company units, NOT filtered by product); default unit when adding a product = product.units[0] || defaultUnits[0]. Tooltip when locked: "'Quantity Requested' and 'Unit of Measurement' cannot be modified".

Sheet quantity cell: options = all company unit symbols (units prop = selectDefaultUnits); on product select, quantity-group cells get postfix = product.data.units[0].symbol and price-group cells '/<symbol>' (only if qty empty).
freeze_default_uom (newTradeConfig.disableUOMPicker, from /v1/trade/new_request_config) hides the UnitPicker when the product has units -> unit is fixed to product default.

No template-level unit restriction found in the dashboard. UnitPicker filters by case-insensitive substring search only; if no match and allow_user_to_add_uom, shows 'Create <text>' -> AddUnit form (POST /units {name,symbol}; name/symbol required, max 15 chars, symbol /^[a-zA-Z0-9\s-]+$/ else 'Invalid input', 'Symbol is already taken'), then refetches dashboard config, 'Unit added successfully'. If no match and not allowed -> antd <Empty/> (no text).
No client-side 'Unit not found' / 'not available' / 'select a valid unit' message exists in src (grep of src + translations for unit/uom messages found none).
